properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration-properties
properties.description: Externalized properties for MyBatis configuration.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.aggressive-lazy-loading
properties.description: When enabled, any method call will load all the lazy properties of the object. Otherwise, each property is loaded on demand (see also lazyLoadTriggerMethods). Default is false.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.arg-name-based-constructor-auto-mapping
properties.description: When applying constructor auto-mapping, argument name is used to search the column to map instead of relying on the column order. Default is false.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.auto-mapping-behavior
properties.description: Specifies if and how MyBatis should automatically map columns to fields/properties. NONE disables auto-mapping. PARTIAL will only auto-map results with no nested result mappings defined inside. FULL will auto-map result mappings of any complexity (containing nested or otherwise). Default is PARTIAL.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.auto-mapping-unknown-column-behavior
properties.description: Specify the behavior when detects an unknown column (or unknown property type) of automatic mapping target. Default is NONE.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.cache-enabled
properties.description: Globally enables or disables any caches configured in any mapper under this configuration. Default is true.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.call-setters-on-nulls
properties.description: Specifies if setters or map's put method will be called when a retrieved value is null. It is useful when you rely on Map.keySet() or null value initialization. Note primitives such as (int,boolean,etc.) will not be set to null. Default is false.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.configuration-factory
properties.description: Specifies the class that provides an instance of Configuration. The returned Configuration instance is used to load lazy properties of deserialized objects. This class must have a method with a signature static Configuration getConfiguration().

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.default-enum-type-handler
properties.description: Specifies the TypeHandler used by default for Enum.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.default-executor-type
properties.description: Configures the default executor. SIMPLE executor does nothing special. REUSE executor reuses prepared statements. BATCH executor reuses statements and batches updates. Default is SIMPLE.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.default-fetch-size
properties.description: Sets the driver a hint as to control fetching size for return results. This parameter value can be override by a query setting.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.default-result-set-type
properties.description: Specifies a scroll strategy when omit it per statement settings.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.default-sql-provider-type
properties.description: Specifies an sql provider class that holds provider method. This class apply to the type(or value) attribute on sql provider annotation(e.g. @SelectProvider), when these attribute was omitted.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.default-statement-timeout
properties.description: Sets the number of seconds the driver will wait for a response from the database.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.jdbc-type-for-null
properties.description: Specifies the JDBC type for null values when no specific JDBC type was provided for the parameter. Some drivers require specifying the column JDBC type but others work with generic values like NULL, VARCHAR or OTHER. Default is OTHER.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.lazy-load-trigger-methods
properties.description: Specifies which Object's methods trigger a lazy load. Default is [equals,clone,hashCode,toString].

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.lazy-loading-enabled
properties.description: Globally enables or disables lazy loading. When enabled, all relations will be lazily loaded. This value can be superseded for a specific relation by using the fetchType attribute on it. Default is False.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.local-cache-scope
properties.description: MyBatis uses local cache to prevent circular references and speed up repeated nested queries. By default (SESSION) all queries executed during a session are cached. If localCacheScope=STATEMENT local session will be used just for statement execution, no data will be shared between two different calls to the same SqlSession. Default is SESSION.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.log-impl
properties.description: Specifies which logging implementation MyBatis should use. If this setting is not present logging implementation will be autodiscovered.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.log-prefix
properties.description: Specifies the prefix string that MyBatis will add to the logger names.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.map-underscore-to-camel-case
properties.description: Enables automatic mapping from classic database column names A_COLUMN to camel case classic Java property names aColumn. Default is true.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.multiple-result-sets-enabled
properties.description: Allows or disallows multiple ResultSets to be returned from a single statement (compatible driver required). Default is true.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.nullable-on-for-each
properties.description: Specifies the default value of 'nullable' attribute on 'foreach' tag. Default is false.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.return-instance-for-empty-row
properties.description: MyBatis, by default, returns null when all the columns of a returned row are NULL. When this setting is enabled, MyBatis returns an empty instance instead. Note that it is also applied to nested results (i.e. collectioin and association). Default is false.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.safe-result-handler-enabled
properties.description: Allows using ResultHandler on nested statements. If allow, set the false. Default is true.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.safe-row-bounds-enabled
properties.description: Allows using RowBounds on nested statements. If allow, set the false. Default is false.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.shrink-whitespaces-in-sql
properties.description: Removes extra whitespace characters from the SQL. Note that this also affects literal strings in SQL. Default is false.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.use-actual-param-name
properties.description: Allow referencing statement parameters by their actual names declared in the method signature. To use this feature, your project must be compiled in Java 8 with -parameters option. Default is true.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.use-column-label
properties.description: Uses the column label instead of the column name. Different drivers behave differently in this respect. Refer to the driver documentation, or test out both modes to determine how your driver behaves. Default is true.

properties.name: mybatis-flex.configuration.use-generated-keys
properties.description: Allows JDBC support for generated keys. A compatible driver is required. This setting forces generated keys to be used if set to true, as some drivers deny compatibility but still work (e.g. Derby). Default is false.
